CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION n8n_tool_get_context(
  p_session_id text,
  p_client_ref text,
  p_caller text,
  p_query text,
  p_top_k int
) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_k int := GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_top_k, 6), 20));
  v_history jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_facts jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_links jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_chunks jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_steps jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public.agent_memory') IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p_session_id,''), '') <> '' THEN
    EXECUTE $q$
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT role, content, created_at
        FROM agent_memory
        WHERE session_id = $1
        ORDER BY created_at DESC
        LIMIT 20
      ) t
    $q$ USING p_session_id INTO v_history;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.memory_facts') IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p_client_ref,''), '') <> '' THEN
    EXECUTE $q$
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.confidence DESC, t.updated_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT fact_key, fact_value, confidence, updated_at
        FROM memory_facts
        WHERE client_ref = $1 AND is_active = true
        ORDER BY confidence DESC, updated_at DESC
        LIMIT 20
      ) t
    $q$ USING p_client_ref INTO v_facts;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.client_source_links') IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p_client_ref,''), '') <> '' THEN
    EXECUTE $q$
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT external_system, external_locator, record_key, source_status, updated_at
        FROM client_source_links
        WHERE client_ref = $1
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC
        LIMIT 10
      ) t
    $q$ USING p_client_ref INTO v_links;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.knowledge_chunks') IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_query),''), '') = '' THEN
      EXECUTE $q$
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t.chunk_text), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM (
          SELECT chunk_text
          FROM knowledge_chunks
          WHERE is_active = true
          ORDER BY updated_at DESC
          LIMIT $1
        ) t
      $q$ USING v_k INTO v_chunks;
    ELSE
      EXECUTE $q$
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t.chunk_text), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM (
          SELECT chunk_text, ts_rank_cd(search_tsv, plainto_tsquery('russian', $2)) AS rank
          FROM knowledge_chunks
          WHERE is_active = true
            AND search_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('russian', $2)
          ORDER BY rank DESC, updated_at DESC
          LIMIT $1
        ) t
      $q$ USING v_k, p_query INTO v_chunks;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.script_steps') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.script_templates') IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE $q$
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.step_order), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT ss.step_order, ss.step_name, ss.step_goal, ss.example_phrase
        FROM script_steps ss
        JOIN script_templates st ON st.id = ss.template_id
        WHERE st.status = 'active'
        ORDER BY ss.step_order
        LIMIT 12
      ) t
    $q$ INTO v_steps;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'session_id', p_session_id,
    'client_ref', p_client_ref,
    'caller', p_caller,
    'query', p_query,
    'history', v_history,
    'memory_facts', v_facts,
    'source_links', v_links,
    'knowledge_chunks', v_chunks,
    'script_steps', v_steps
  );
END;
$$;

SELECT n8n_tool_get_context($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::int) AS context_payload;
